question: 这段观测能不能用来做 1–12 Hz 的 P/S 拾取？

finish_audit.note: 本审计只读取本轮实际状态；它不补做检查、不发请求、不调用模型，也不会把缺失的完成标志补成成功。

next_action.why: 1 station(s) carry measurable band data, so the asked band question is answerable for the reviewed set (stations not acquired remain unknown)

limitations: Scope was a single explicit candidate (CHIMA / cf3bfe63e905); no network-wide statement is made about whether other stations support a 1–12 Hz three-component P/S pick.
No new acquisition was permitted, so no additional station could be added to test the 1–12 Hz band or to widen the three-component evidence.

Sampling-rate support for the 1–12 Hz band is met (100 Hz, Nyquist 50 Hz, required 24 Hz) and all three components Z/N/E are present, aligned and 12001 samples; no channel-integrity flag was raised, and channel health was judged from those measured flags only.
The onset check (method band 1–8 Hz) returned no pick time (onset_utc null), i.e. no arrival time is available for this station in this window.

The diagnostic grid actually run was [3–12 Hz] (this round's declared grid, not the 1–12 Hz target band). With 13 configurations only 1 was valid: stalta_z produced 0 picks in 4 3–12 Hz configurations, ar_aic_3c produced 1 pick (2.53 s) in its 1–20 Hz configuration; the check therefore reported insufficient_configurations / spread 0.0 s and cannot confirm the onset as stable or reproducible.

Consequently this answer does not establish the existence of a coherent P/S arrival; it establishes only that the stored observation is band- and component-capable for the goal while the pick itself is unconfirmed.
